en: Black‑and‑white view down a gently sloping cobblestone street in a European town, lined with multi‑story historic buildings with shuttered windows and shop signs. On the left corner is a shop with large display windows and German signage; on the right are more businesses and houses. A few pedestrians and two boys with a bicycle stand in the street. In the distance rises a tall church tower with a pointed spire and a clock face. The overall look suggests an early‑20th‑century urban scene.
